instruction: Disconnect USB and wait for the power LED to go out. Remove only the large-board E30–A55 OUT-load jumper. Keep A55–C35 absent, the B28–B35 1 kohm resistor, B50–B23, D55–D60 load and C23–A60 REF return, and all specimen wiring unchanged. Remove probes and reconnect the same USB port.

fixed_response.verbatim: USB was off; I disconnected only the known output-load jumper, retained the specimen and remaining wiring, removed probes, and reconnected the same USB port.
